glossary.definition: (1) "Food" has the same meaning as in section 3715.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3719.44 - Board of pharmacy authority to change schedules.

glossary.definition: (2) "Dietary supplement" has the same meaning as in the "Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act," 108 Stat. 4327 (1994), 21 U.S.C.A. 321 (ff), as amended.
glossary.source_title: Section 3719.44 - Board of pharmacy authority to change schedules.

glossary.definition: (3) "Ephedrine alkaloids" means ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, norephedrine, norpseudoephedrine, methylephedrine, and methylpseudoephedrine.
glossary.source_title: Section 3719.44 - Board of pharmacy authority to change schedules.
